en.title: Fixed prepositions with verbs and adjectives
en.summary: Some verbs and adjectives always take a particular preposition.

paragraphs: Many English verbs and adjectives are followed by a particular preposition, and the choice is not logical: you listen to music, you depend on someone, and you are afraid of dogs. The combinations must be learned together with the word.

blocks.html:
PrepositionAdjectivesExample
atgood, bad, brilliant, surprisedHe is good at football.
ofafraid, proud, tired, full, fondShe is afraid of spiders.
ininterested, involvedI'm interested in art.
aboutworried, excited, angryThey are worried about money.
withpleased, bored, angry, satisfiedI'm bored with this.
tomarried, similar, kindShe is married to a doctor.
forfamous, ready, responsibleParis is famous for its food.
fromdifferent, absentThis is different from that.

PrepositionVerbsExample
ondepend, rely, insist, concentrateIt depends on the weather.
tolisten, belong, talk, apologiseListen to me.
forwait, look, ask, pay, searchI'm waiting for you.
atlook, laugh, smile, shoutLook at this.
ofthink, dream, consist, remindI'm thinking of you.
abouttalk, think, worry, careTell me about it.
inbelieve, succeed, specialiseI believe in luck.
withagree, deal, copeI agree with you.

sections.title: Verbs with no preposition in English

paragraphs: Some verbs that take a preposition in other languages take a direct object in English: discuss, enter, marry, answer, approach, resemble. We discussed the plan, not discussed about the plan.

items: Wrong: **I'm agree with you.** Right: **I agree with you.**
Wrong: **We discussed about the problem.** Right: **We discussed the problem.**
Wrong: **She is afraid from dogs.** Right: **of dogs**
Wrong: **He is different than me.** (informal US) Careful style: **different from me**

ro.title: Prepoziții fixe cu verbe și adjective
ro.summary: În limba română, multe verbe și adjective cer o prepoziție fixă pentru a lega alte cuvinte.

paragraphs: Unele verbe și adjective se folosesc mereu cu o anumită prepoziție. Alegerea acestei prepoziții nu este întotdeauna logică. Trebuie să înveți verbul sau adjectivul împreună cu prepoziția potrivită. Cele mai multe prepoziții fixe cer cazul acuzativ.

Prepoziția stă de obicei după verb sau după adjectiv. După prepoziție adaugi un substantiv sau un pronume. De regulă, aceste cuvinte sunt în cazul acuzativ. Învață aceste grupuri de cuvinte ca pe o singură unitate.

blocks.html:

a depindedeTotul depinde de noi.
